snippet.description:
Preparing for Indian Polity for UPSC Prelims 2027? Memorising constitutional facts alone may not be enough to tackle UPSC's increasingly application-based questions.

🔗 Explore PMP 2027: https://shorturl.at/iOGm6
📌 Heatmaps: https://zfrmz.in/CmkNwNqn5LvZYQ7ZnSak

In this session, Babu Gunasekaran Sir explains the changing nature of UPSC Polity questions, common mistakes aspirants make, and how to approach Polity PYQs for better conceptual clarity and accuracy.

In this session:
- Factual vs conceptual vs application-based Polity questions
- Why knowing constitutional Articles isn't enough
- How to analyse Polity PYQs effectively
- Common mistakes in constitutional provisions
- Polity preparation approach through PMP 2027

YouTube Chapters — Polity Prelims 2027

01:14 Polity Weightage in UPSC Prelims
02:17 How UPSC Polity Questions Are Changing

07:36 Limited Resources & Constitution-Based Preparation
09:34 PMP Polity: Notes, Practice Questions & PYQs
12:55 Why Students Make Mistakes in Polity
